cards.title: Everything that happened, in order
cards.text: 4 on-track passes, 28 pit stops, 7 cars that never finished, 1 safety car and a red flag that stopped the race.

cards.title: 9 places changed hands on track before the first lap was done
cards.text: 22 cars into the first corner on cold tyres and full tanks.
bullets: Alonso and Perez gained the most by the end of it, 4 places each
cards.note: Most of this is the pack sorting itself out. Some of it decides the race.

cards.title: 19 incidents looked at
cards.text: Every one of them logged by race control during the race.
bullets: Lap 1: Perez, false start
10 ended in a penalty, 8 in no further action and 1 left for after the race

cards.title: Verstappen is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 1 of 78, in a Red Bull.
bullets: Started P2
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Alonso starts P21. Where does he finish?
cards.text: 78 laps to make up ground from there.

cards.title: 10 penalties handed out
cards.text: Given by the stewards during the race.
bullets: Perez: a drive-through for out of position
Hamilton: a 5s penalty for speeding in the pit lane
Russell: a 5s penalty for speeding in the pit lane
And 7 more
cards.note: A time penalty is served at the next stop, or added to the final time when there is no stop left. A drive-through is a trip down the pit lane at the speed limit without stopping.

cards.title: 29 lap times deleted
cards.text: The white line is the track, and the lap simply stops counting if you leave it.
bullets: Stroll lost 4 that way, more than anybody
cards.note: Keep doing it and it turns into a penalty.

cards.title: Bottas is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 16 of 78, in a Cadillac.
bullets: P19 at the start of lap 15
Started P20
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Track at 43°C at the start, falling to 32°C at the flag
cards.text: Track temperature changes how much grip the tyres find and how fast they wear. No rain was recorded during the race.

cards.title: Bearman is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 28 of 78, in a Haas.
bullets: P20 at the start of lap 27
Started P19
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.kicker: Your call on the pit wall
cards.title: You are Piastri, 2.2s behind Russell and going nowhere. Now what?
cards.text: Stuck behind another car your tyres overheat and the car will not turn. Stopping first gives you clean track for two or three laps, which is the whole trick behind the undercut.

choices.label: Box now and undercut
choices.sub: Fresh tyres, clean air, two laps to make it pay

choices.label: Stay out and overcut
choices.sub: Let him stop first, then push on an empty track

choices.label: Forget strategy, pass him
choices.sub: Send it and take the risk

outcomes.box: You spend about 25s in the lane and come out in traffic, betting that two fast laps on new tyres are worth more than the place you just gave up.
outcomes.wait: You stay on old rubber while he gets new ones, and you need clean air plus a mistake from him to make it work.
outcomes.attack: Passing a car with the same tyres on the same fuel is the hardest thing in the sport, and running into the back of him ends both races.

cards.reveal: Piastri came in on lap 48, 17 laps after this. He finished P4, Russell P12.

cards.title: Russell: 15 laps within a second of the car ahead
cards.text: The longest unbroken run like it in the race, from lap 18 to lap 32, at racing speed.
bullets: 5 other drivers had a run of five laps or more like it
cards.note: Following closely costs the car downforce and cooks the front tyres, so sitting there is harder than it looks.

cards.title: Bortoleto hit 287 km/h
cards.text: The fastest car in a straight line is often not the fastest car over a lap.
bullets: Bortoleto did it in an Audi
cards.note: Top speed says as much about wing level, and about sitting in somebody's tow, as it does about the engine.

cards.title: 28 stops, and the busiest lap saw 3 of them
cards.text: Once one car stops, the cars around it have to answer.
bullets: 3 cars in on each of laps 1, 59 and 60
Shortest time in the pit lane: Russell, 24.0s
Longest: Russell, 35.2s
cards.note: Pit lane time runs from the entry line to the exit line, stop included.

cards.title: Who has the fastest lap on the board at the flag?
cards.text: It usually lands late, when the car is light and the track has rubber all over it.
cards.reveal: Antonelli on lap 76, 1:13.481, in a Mercedes.

cards.title: Bortoleto stopped 3 times
cards.text: Three stops when most of the field made 1.
bullets: In on laps 1, 43 and 59
One of them under a safety car or VSC

cards.title: Norris is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 44 of 78, in a McLaren.
bullets: P6 at the start of lap 43
Started P8
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: 126 blue flags waved
cards.text: That is how often a lapped car was told to let the leaders through.

cards.title: Antonelli had the quickest median racing lap
cards.text: No lap 1, no laps in or out of the pits, nothing behind the safety car or the VSC, and the slow outliers trimmed. It does not always match the result.

cards.title: Stroll is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 57 of 78, in an Aston Martin.
bullets: P16 at the start of lap 56
Started P22
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Every gap on track, erased
cards.text: The field bunches up behind the safety car, and whatever anybody had built is gone.
bullets: Antonelli was leading when it came out
He took a stop under it, and so did Alonso, Piastri, Perez and 4 others
It ended in a red flag on lap 68

cards.kicker: Your call on the pit wall
cards.title: Safety car with 18 laps left. You are leading. Box or stay out?
cards.text: The pack is bunched up behind you and a stop costs far less than usual, except that everybody behind can copy you and the one who does not gets the lead.
state: Wiped out by the safety car

choices.label: Box for fresh tyres
choices.sub: Grip for the restart, hand over track position

choices.label: Stay out and defend
choices.sub: Keep the lead on older tyres

outcomes.box: New rubber under a safety car is close to free, and it only works if the cars behind stay out. If they all follow you in, you have spent your lead for nothing.
outcomes.stay: You keep the lead and restart on older tyres, with a queue of fresher cars in your mirrors and no gap to hide in.

cards.reveal: Antonelli came in. At the flag it was P1 Antonelli, P2 Hamilton, P3 Hadjar.

cards.title: Yellow flags out 4 times
cards.text: Race control waves a yellow for anything on or near the track that should not be there.
bullets: A yellow means slow down and do not overtake in that part of the track
Track sector 18 saw 4 calls, more than anywhere else

cards.title: Leclerc is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 65 of 78, in a Ferrari.
bullets: P3 at the start of lap 64
Started P4
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Ocon and Lindblad ran one set for 58 laps each
cards.text: The longest anybody stayed out on one set.
bullets: Ocon: hards, lap 9 to 66
Lindblad: mediums, lap 1 to 58
cards.note: Every lap you stretch is a lap you do not lose in the pit lane. And every lap you stretch is a set of tyres getting slower underneath you.

cards.title: One of these three does not see the chequered flag. Who?
cards.text: Nothing on the timing screens says it is coming.
cards.reveal: Sainz, on lap 71 of 78. Race control had logged an incident involving Colapinto and Sainz at Turn 8 on lap 71.

cards.title: The race was stopped
cards.text: A safety car first, then the red flag: everybody into the pit lane and a wait for the track to be made safe.
bullets: Antonelli was leading when it happened
Standing restart on lap 70
cards.note: Teams can change tyres while the cars wait, which rewrites the strategies on the grid.

cards.title: Sainz is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 71 of 78, in a Williams.
bullets: P10 at the start of lap 70
Started P12
1 on-track pass before it happened
Race control logged an incident with Colapinto and Sainz at Turn 8 on lap 71

cards.title: Lap 71: contact between Colapinto and Sainz at Turn 8. What do you give?
cards.text: Race control has flagged it and it lands on your desk. Same call the stewards had to make.

outcomes.none: You let it go. Nobody loses a place at a desk, and the driver behind spends the rest of the race on the radio.
outcomes.5: Five seconds gets added at the next stop, or to the final time if there is no stop left. Usually one position, sometimes none.
outcomes.10: Ten seconds is a real punishment and it almost always costs track position, which is why teams argue so hard about it.

cards.reveal: The stewards took no further action.

cards.title: Sainz was P10 a lap before his race ended on lap 71. Where does he finish if it had not?
cards.text: Nobody can answer this one for certain. You have his own lap times to go on and nothing else.

choices.label: He keeps it in the points
He drops out of the points

cards.reveal: Our read from his own lap times, not a fact. He was lapping 2.45s a lap slower than Antonelli, who went on to win it. With 7 laps left, "he keeps it in the points" is the honest guess, and nobody gets to check. Race control had logged an incident involving Colapinto and Sainz on lap 71.

cards.title: Russell went the other way: 6 places lost
cards.text: Qualifying promised one thing and the race delivered another.
bullets: P6 on the grid, P12 at the flag
2 stops when most of the field made 1
Qualifying rewards whoever can put one lap together. A race asks for 78 of them

cards.title: Alonso: P21 on the grid, P10 at the flag
cards.text: 11 places gained.
bullets: 6 cars that started ahead of him retired

cards.title: Antonelli: 1:13.481
cards.text: The quickest anybody went all race, in a Mercedes.
bullets: Set on lap 76 of 78, late on, where they usually land
By then the fuel is nearly gone and the car is at its lightest
It is worth no points: the bonus point for it was dropped after 2024

cards.title: Antonelli wins it
cards.text: P1 Antonelli · P2 Hamilton · P3 Hadjar.
bullets: After 78 laps, Hamilton crossed the line 6.271s behind

cards.title: How far behind was Hamilton at the flag?
cards.text: 78 laps, 1 hour 47 minutes of racing, and it comes down to this one number.
cards.reveal: 6.271 seconds after 78 laps. A trip down the pit lane took about 25s today, which is 4 times the margin this race was decided by.
